title: Padded shape and expanded read
hints: `pads` holds two numbers per axis, so walk both lists together: one size from `shape`, two amounts from `pads`.
For `pad_shape`, match on `shape, pads` with the pattern `d :: s, l :: r :: p` and build `(d + l + r) :: pad_shape s p`. The function needs `let rec`.
For `expand_src`, use `List.map2 (fun d i -> if d = 1 then 0 else i) shape idx`.

answer.explain: `pad_shape` adds each axis's two pad amounts to its size, so `[2; 2]` with `[0; 1; 2; 0]` is `[3; 4]`. `expand_src` reads every size-1 axis at 0 and leaves the other axes alone, so in a `(3, 1)` value expanded to `(3, 4)`, output `[2][3]` reads `x[2][0]`.
